source.label: t1
source.quote: Suppose Assumptions~\ref{assume:B}, \ref{assume:Distribution} and \ref{assume:incoherence} hold. Pick $\delta_0 < 0.1$ and $\NSR := \frac{T \sigma^2}{\sigma_{\min}^{\star^2}}$ is the noise-to-signal ratio. If $N_1 T > C \mu^2 \kappa^2 L^2 d(N-N_1)\left(r\kappa^2+\NSR\right)$, then with probability at least $1-2\delta-\exp(-c(d+T))$, the cumulative regret of our proposed algorithm is bounded by $\pR_\NT=\widetilde{O}(\sigma_{\min}^\star\sqrt{drNT}(\sqrt{\NSR}+(\sqrt{\lambda}+\sqrt{\frac{\lambda}{N-N_1}}+1)\kappa))$.

results.notes: Paper's N (rounds) mapped to canonical T; paper's T (tasks) declared as n_tasks. Regret is pseudo-regret summed over tasks, holding w.p. 1-2delta-exp(-c(d+T)). Comparator is per-task optimal action. Theorem 4 (confidence set) not recorded as a performance guarantee.
